versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ps2-bios-checksum skill.
- Checks local PlayStation 2 BIOS files for MD5 and SHA-1 hashes.
- Reports file size and flags files outside typical BIOS sizes (2/4/8/16 MiB) or empty files.
- Allows optional comparison against a user-supplied expected hash.
- Does not provide or link to BIOS downloads; references only.
